🚀 Welcome to Space Racing!

⚙️ Use energy cores and treadmill boosters to upgrade your spaceship’s power!
🌠 Race across galaxies at light-speed to earn wins and cosmic rewards!
🌌 Explore new planets and dimensions to unlock legendary space vessels!
🏆 Climb the leaderboards and become the ultimate intergalactic pilot!

🎁 New Code: RELEASE

💎 Premium players get +15% energy every session!

👍 Like, favourite, and follow if you enjoyed the game — and get ready for liftoff!
